name: Pancreas
description: Retroperitoneal gland extending from the duodenal C-loop (head) to the splenic hilum (tail). Parts: head, uncinate process, neck, body, tail. The main pancreatic duct (Wirsung) joins the common bile duct at the ampulla of Vater. On CT: assess for masses, duct dilatation (>3 mm), calcifications, peripancreatic fat stranding, and atrophy.
